definitions.gloss: advance; expansion; entry into (a market, field, or area)
definitions.explanation: Moving forward into a new area, whether in business (entering a new market), sports (advancing to the next round), or other competitive contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{進出|しんしゅつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{準決勝|じゅんけっしょう}→準決勝：04911_junkesshou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{進出|しんしゅつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The team advanced to the semifinals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自動車|じどうしゃ}→自動車：02886_jidousha⟧⟦メーカー→メーカー：11158_meekaa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦アジア→アジア：01763_ajia⟧⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{進出|しんしゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加速|かそく}→加速：00198_kasoku⟧⟦させている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Japanese automakers are accelerating their expansion into Asian markets.

notes:
USAGE:
{進出|しんしゅつ} implies actively moving into a new sphere of activity. It is most commonly used in business (entering markets) and sports (advancing in tournaments).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{進出|しんしゅつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to advance/expand into...)
- ⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{進出|しんしゅつ} (expansion into...)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧{進出|しんしゅつ} (overseas expansion)
- ⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧{進出|しんしゅつ} (market entry)
- ⟦{決勝|けっしょう}→決勝：04742_kesshou⟧{進出|しんしゅつ} (advancing to the finals)
- {進出|しんしゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧ (to achieve an advance/entry)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{参入|さんにゅう}→参入：09939_sannyuu⟧ (market entry) focuses specifically on joining a market or industry. {進出|しんしゅつ} is broader and can cover geographic expansion, sports advancement, or entering new fields.
